name: Condor & caracaras
description: The scavenger guild - the Andean condor (Vultur gryphus) and the caracaras: southern carancho austral (Phalcoboenus australis), white-throated caracara araucano (P. albogularis) and the crested caracara traro (Caracara plancus). Functional group pooling 4 source nodes (4 native, 0 exotic, 0 mixed-origin); the paper describes these facultative and strict scavengers as direct beneficiaries of the rabbit subsidy, and their carrion links to livestock, guanaco and puma are documented feeding records.
